## Google Places Prospecting

Config: supabaseServiceRoleKey + skipDays.
Nearby/Text/Deep*: Header Auth credential.

**Pacing (600 Nearby/dk limiti):**
- Split batchSize=1
- HTTP batchInterval=250ms (~4 req/sn, limitin altinda)
- Retry On Fail KAPALI (429'u hemen tekrar deneme)

Deepen: kirpilan hucre radius/2 x4 (max depth 2).
Mark: 429 ilcelere son_tarama yazmaz; kirpilanlari yogun_bolge=true yapar.

SplitInBatches v3: [0]=done, [1]=loop.
